role: Shared raster torso, arms, wrists and hands; programmed SVG head/face is composited above it.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a professionally illustrated 2D BODY LAYER for a clean Korean pastel mobile counseling game. Adult male, front-facing, plain sage green short-sleeve T-shirt, complete arms gently bent at the elbows, hands resting at the lower abdomen with one relaxed hand lightly resting on the opposite wrist. Natural adult shoulder, upper arm, forearm, wrist, finger and thumb anatomy. Only neck and body; no head, no face, no hair, because the app draws the face separately. Professional simple editorial vector illustration style, FLAT SOLID FILLS, crisp clean edges, very restrained details. T-shirt one solid pastel sage #A5C3AC with just two small flat crease shapes in #91AF99. Skin solid warm peach #F2C6AC with narrow flat finger detail strokes in #DFAE93. NO gradients or soft shading, no texture, no shadows, no black areas, no accessories, no text. OPAQUE UNIFORM LIGHT MINT BACKGROUND #DCEBDF throughout the entire square image, absolutely no transparent pixels or holes. Centered body on square canvas, neck at top center, around 6 percent margin around the entire silhouette, both elbows and hands fully in frame. The bottom edge of the shirt is below the hands. Make the hands look professionally drawn, relaxed and anatomically believable, with no interlaced fingers. The entire shirt is a continuous solid filled shape.
